bottomSlot.zh-CN: 底部渲染额外元素的 snippet。
bottomSlot.en-US: Snippet that renders extra elements at the bottom.

children.zh-CN: usePopover 时作为触发器的 snippet，默认是当前颜色的色块；不使用 usePopover 时不渲染。
children.en-US: Snippet used as the trigger when usePopover is on, a swatch of the current color by default; not rendered without usePopover.

defaultFormat.zh-CN: 手动输入时默认使用的颜色格式，可选 `rgba`、`hex`、`hsva`。
defaultFormat.en-US: Color format used by default for manual input: `rgba`, `hex` or `hsva`.

eyeDropper.en-US: Whether to enable the eyedropper color picker.

height.zh-CN: 高度，单位为像素，未设置时为 280。
height.en-US: Height in pixels; 280 when not set.

onChange.zh-CN: 用户选中颜色时的回调，参数为 ColorValue，包含 hsva、hex、rgba 三种格式。
onChange.en-US: Called with a ColorValue, holding hsva, hex and rgba, when the user picks a color.

popoverProps.zh-CN: 放入 Popover 时传给 Popover 的属性，如 `trigger`、`aria-label`、`aria-labelledby`。弹层默认以点击触发、role 为 `dialog`，名称默认取语言包；`aria-label` 或 `aria-labelledby` 优先。
popoverProps.en-US: Props passed to the Popover when usePopover is on, such as `trigger`, `aria-label` and `aria-labelledby`. The popup opens on click with role `dialog` by default and takes its name from the locale; `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` takes precedence.

topSlot.zh-CN: 顶部渲染额外元素的 snippet。
topSlot.en-US: Snippet that renders extra elements at the top.

usePopover.zh-CN: 是否放入 Popover 渲染，触发器使用 `children`，默认 false。
usePopover.en-US: Whether to render inside a Popover; the trigger is `children`. Defaults to false.

value.zh-CN: 颜色值，可 `bind:value`，是同时包含 hsva、hex、rgba 三种格式的对象。不传时由组件自行管理，初始为 `#39c5bb`；单向 `value={x}` 只作初值，要完全受控用函数绑定 `bind:value={get, set}`；`null` 是受控的空值，显示默认色且只报告变化。ColorValue 按不可变值对待，更新时整体替换。
value.en-US: The color, supports `bind:value`; an object holding hsva, hex and rgba. Left out, the component manages it and starts at `#39c5bb`. A one-way `value={x}` only seeds it; for a fully controlled picker use the function binding `bind:value={get, set}`. `null` is a controlled empty value: it shows the default color and only reports changes. Treat ColorValue as immutable and replace it as a whole.

width.zh-CN: 宽度，单位为像素，未设置时为 280。
width.en-US: Width in pixels; 280 when not set.

getRoot.zh-CN: 返回 picker 根元素；usePopover 时位于弹层内，弹层关闭时为 null。
getRoot.en-US: Returns the picker root element; inside the popup when usePopover is on, so null while the popup is closed.
